description: Authorizes vendor payments after validating vendor eligibility, invoice verification, payment approval, available funds, and payment risk assessment.

unboundSignalReasons.vendorVerified: Independently attested by upstream vendor verification; no Intent-side equivalent field exists to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.invoiceVerified: Result of an independent invoice-verification check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.paymentApproved: Attested by a separate payment-approval step; the Intent carries no approval-status field to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.sufficientFunds: Result of an independent funds-availability check against account state; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed payment-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Vendor payment authorized. Vendor verification, invoice verification, payment approval, funding, and risk assessment requirements were satisfied.
Vendor payment rejected because the assessed payment risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Vendor payment rejected because the vendor has not been verified.
Vendor payment rejected because the invoice has not been verified.
Vendor payment rejected because the required payment approval has not been granted.
Vendor payment rejected because sufficient funds are not available.
Vendor payment rejected because the payment amount must be greater than zero.
Vendor payment rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
